title: Percentages in Seconds
summary: Build percentages from 10 percent and its halves.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: A shirt costs 840 rupees. It is on sale at 15 percent off.
points: A shirt costs 840 rupees. It is on sale at 15 percent off.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Use easy pieces: 10 percent is simple, and 5 percent is half of that.

steps.title: The method: Build from 10 percent
sentences: 10 percent of 840 is 84, just move the decimal one place.
5 percent is half of 84, which is 42.
